eligibility_evidence: This role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of end-user support; server, identity, collaboration, backup, and storage platforms across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments; and the hybrid network that connects offices, retail locations, warehouse f
Based in the Dallas area, the Director works on-site at the Richardson, TX office several days a week and serves as the senior IT operations leader for that location.

Oversee the hybrid network environment, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls and VPN, WAN and internet connectivity, and the program to replace Cisco cloud services routers with cloud-native connectivity between Azure, AWS, and company sites.
Lead IT delivery for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and site upgrades, coordinating network, infrastructure, end-user equipment, and Service Desk readiness.

Serve as the primary liaison between Platform Operations and the Security and Site Reliability (SSRE) team; partner with Information Security on patching, vulnerability remediation, access controls, logging, and segmentation, and support PCI, SOX, and other audit and control requirements.
